inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to renegotiate the 2009 agreement before an indefinite nationwide strike. Students and families could suffer most from another disruption, but blaming workers for that would let the government off the hook. Staff should not have to threaten a strike to make unresolved commitments count. The government needs to negotiate in good faith now: a functioning university system depends on respecting workers’ rights as well as protecting students’ education.
